//: Four profiles, one per audience. The only thing that ever differs
between them is which backend the binary points at and how it is
signed — never app behaviour, which is server-flagged (/api/v1/meta).
appVersionSource=remote means EAS owns build numbers. Nobody edits an
iOS buildNumber or an Android versionCode by hand; a duplicate is the
single most common cause of a rejected upload.

ios.//: ascAppId and the Apple IDs are filled in after the app record exists in App Store Connect; they are not secrets.

android.//: Service-account JSON stays out of the repo; point this at a path supplied by CI or a local file listed in .gitignore.
